connector.name: DB MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Database MCP server for MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and SQLite with SSH tunneling support.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package db-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the stucchi account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DB_USER
env.description: Database user (MySQL default: root, PostgreSQL default: postgres)

env.name: DB_URL
env.description: MongoDB connection URL (required for MongoDB, e.g. mongodb://...)

env.name: SSH_HOST
env.description: SSH bastion host for tunneling (MySQL/PostgreSQL only)
